gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-tamil-suppl: Paper shows through a thin line between the letters of Wallpoet, and its smooth curves and high lowercase feel bold and commanding. Wallpoet shouts; Noto Sans Tamil Supplement settles into round, stocky lines.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Wallpoet leaves a hairline of paper running between its bold letters. Noto Sans Tangsa follows with wide, inviting round letters and short ascender stems, so the loud heading hands off to something approachable.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-tc: Commanding and smooth, Wallpoet rounds every bend with a thin line of paper showing between letters. Noto Sans TC handles the quiet work, its large open counters and outward curves made for text.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Wallpoet is bold and commanding, with a smooth path round each bend and high-rising lowercase. And Noto Sans Telugu keeps text moving steadily, its high midline and open counters making paragraphs feel orderly.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-thai: Loud, smooth and split by thin lines of paper, Wallpoet sits above Noto Sans Thai, whose lowercase swells like glass beads. Its open, rounded letters make paragraphs feel friendly and easy going.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-thai-looped: Tall lowercase bodies make this text face look sturdy, with spacious gaps where its curves end. Noto Sans Thai Looped backs the loud, paper-striped Wallpoet heading with clean lines.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Bold Wallpoet slices thin paper lines between its letters. Shrink the heading and that commanding punch fades, while Noto Sans Tifinagh, with its open, inflated bowls, fills the line best at text size.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: Noto Sans Tirhuta brings terminals cut back to leave big gaps, plus a dominant x-height. But beside Wallpoet, whose bold lines are split by paper-thin gaps, it plays the quiet partner.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-ugaritic: Wallpoet runs a thin line of paper between letters, and its lowercase climbs high with smooth, bold curves. Noto Sans Ugaritic does the opposite job, keeping capitals and lowercase close in height with open, chalk-arc mouths.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-vai: Paper-striped and loud, Wallpoet curves smoothly and sends its lowercase high. Noto Sans Vai settles beneath it, its words forming solid blocks with generous space between curve ends and stems.
